Pricing power is modest: yield has ranged 1.71%-2.29% a month over five years and ROCE was above 18% only in FY24.
Holdings_Audit.invalidation_condition: Close below Rs 302.16 (63-day base low 322.90 less 1 ATR) is the intended exit, conditional on execution, not a guaranteed maximum loss; a close below 322.90 voids the entry zone; or 50-DMA crossing below 200-DMA while Test C fails (Stage 4 red line); or Q2 FY27 core rental EBITDA margin below 45% / FY27 EBITDA guidance cut; or gross D/E above 0.72 or total debt above 2.5x operating profit (ICRA downgrade level). Holdings_Audit.investment_thesis: Asia's largest crane renter is growing revenue 39% year on year with 86% fleet utilisation, a Rs 1,253 Cr order book and an A+ rated balance sheet, yet trades at about 14 times earnings, with the price implying only about 2.2% a year of profit growth. The risk is quality of growth: margin dilution, aging receivables, Saudi exposure and negative free cash flow. The 2.2% implied growth is profit-based and is not proof of a cash-based margin of safety.
